change: naive RAG, Tutorial 7 Section 2: get_text(), RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter, lower-cased whitespace tokens, BM25 top-5 over the whole corpus, no query parsing, never []
+ structured parsing: walk h1/h2/h3/p/ul/table as blocks and convert every <table> with table_to_text (row label + column header kept), tables never glued to prose
+ contextual chunk header: prepend 'company | FY | doc_type | section' to every chunk
+ better tokeniser: lower-case, strip stopwords and question scaffolding, light stemming instead of raw whitespace tokens
+ BM25 b=0.3 instead of the default 0.75 (less length normalisation, so a short risk-factor paragraph stops outranking the income statement)
+ parse_query and metadata filtering: rank only the chunks of the asked company, document type and fiscal year
+ query expansion: add the words the corpus uses for the asked attribute (sales -> revenue, headcount -> employees, ...)
+ same-year preference: when the year is asked about, the report of that year is ranked before the other one (it names the CFO in office then)
+ per-company retrieval: rank inside each company's pool and interleave the pools, so a comparison gets a chunk for each company instead of five for one
+ section diversity: at most one chunk per top-level section in each company's queue
+ abstention: return [] when the question asks for an attribute the corpus never mentions (lexical document-frequency check) -- the shipped configuration
